data_fields.name: spawnby_count
data_fields.donor_constant: nspawnby (decoration field; value per decoration not read)

best_idea: Place a building as one stored template, node by node, with a chance per layer, a chance per node, a force-overwrite bit and a quarter-turn, so ruins and variants come from data instead of separate models.
decision_why: One template with per-layer and per-node chance gives ruins and variants for zone landmarks from one asset; the layer-counter defect and the off-by-one chance are fixed in the sketch, and the raw-byte Lua path is rejected as written because values above 127 set the force bit.
acceptance: A zone's ruined chapel is one template where a layer with chance 64 appears in about half of the placements and every node with chance 127 always appears; a zone test places the template with a fixed seed 200 times and asserts that every placed layer lands at origin.y plus its layer index, and that a node with chance 1 never appears.
